algorithms.deviceCredentialCommitment: SHA-256 hex of the PEM string of deviceCredential (DeviceCredentialCommitment.fromCredential).
algorithms.keyDerivation: Ed25519 seed = sha256(utf8("pigeon-vector:identity-signature:<role>")) hex; PKCS#8 private key = 302e020100300506032b657004220420 || seed.
algorithms.signature: Ed25519 over utf8(signingPayload), standard base64 with padding (88 characters). Ed25519 is deterministic, so the signature is byte-exact.
algorithms.signingPayload: utf8("pigeon:identity:v1\n") followed by the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of IdentitySignaturePayload.

cases.name: identity with profile, mailbox home, admission nonce and previous identity

description: Fixed, byte-exact vectors for the identity self-signature preimage (IdentitySignatureDomainService.getCanonicalSigningContent) and the Identity signature verification. Every derived value is computed from the keys and inputs only; tests/unit/contexts/identities/domain/IdentitySignatureVectors.spec.ts recomputes them with the real domain code, so any drift in key order, field set, credential form or signature scheme fails. The UI pins the same signingPayload bytes and signature.
